acceptanceCriteria: An escape audit (or a copy of the canonical bytes) proves the serialized packet does not alias the mapping after Release.
callContext releases its Index; a test shows live mappings return to 0 after eviction in a long-lived bridge process.
No fault or corrupted packet under concurrent context calls (race test).
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator from batch C (branch claude/batch-c-2026-10-07, base 0c94c66c).

V1-0983 (docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0983-snapshot-mapping-lifetime.md, Outcome) added (*Index).Release and wired probeAnalyzerPack, but internal/mcp/bridge/bridge.go callContext is not wired: its Result packet is serialized after the call returns and may alias mapped body text. A long-lived MCP server therefore keeps every snapshot mapping it opens; with ring eviction, live mappings and unreclaimed disk space grow (measured 1 -> 2 -> 3 without Release). Expected: the bridge releases the Index once the packet bytes no longer alias the mapping.
title: MCP bridge: release snapshot mappings after the context call (V1-0983 follow-up)
